# Quality gate — per-function CRAP ratchet via crap4js (IstiN fork).
#
# Policy: CRAP may only DECREASE. The baseline (per-function CRAP of everything above
# CRAP_THRESHOLD) is NOT in the repository …

blocks.text:
# Quality gate — per-function CRAP ratchet via crap4js (IstiN fork).
#
# Policy: CRAP may only DECREASE. The baseline (per-function CRAP of everything above
# CRAP_THRESHOLD) is NOT in the repository — with many agents opening PRs a committed file
# conflicts constantly. It lives in a rolling GitHub release asset:
#
#   release tag  crap-baseline   (prerelease, never "latest" — agent pack consumers resolve
#                                 releases/latest, so this one must not be it)
#   asset        crap-baseline.json
#
# pull_request / workflow_dispatch (the factory SM dispatches this on PR heads): measure the
#   head and COMPARE with the released baseline. Fails when a function's CRAP grew or a new
#   function exceeds CRAP_THRESHOLD; labels crap:regression / crap:improved.
# main (push, merge-bot completion via workflow_run — the bot merges with GITHUB_TOKEN, which
#   never fires 'push' —, or manual dispatch on main): after a green measurement, ratchet the
#   released baseline DOWN (crap4js --update-baseline: min(old, now), never up, refuses on
#   regression) and upload it. The release notes carry 'main@<sha>' so repeated triggers for
#   the same HEAD are skipped. Concurrent merges are serialized by the concurrency group.
# No baseline asset yet (first run / fork): bootstrap from the measured main, no comparison.
#
# Coverage comes from the unit suite run in the same job (instrumented tree), so the
# ratchet is evaluated with the unit-test results of the head.
#
# Tool pin: IstiN/crap4js by commit SHA (fork of vabhzw17eg2qu4m9-bit/crap4js v0.15.0 +
# --baseline / --update-baseline, pipe-safe exit). Installed from GitHub — the npm 'crap4js'
# package is an unrelated third-party project.
name: Quality

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  workflow_run:
    # The merge bot merges with GITHUB_TOKEN, and GitHub suppresses workflow triggers on
    # GITHUB_TOKEN events — the push trigger above never fires for machine merges (same
    # reason agent-pack-release.yml listens to this workflow, gh-867). The bot's own run
    # completion is a normal event. Runs on every bot completion are cheap no-ops: the
    # 'gate' job skips when the baseline already covers main's HEAD.
    workflows: ['Machine Merge Bot']
    types: [completed]
  pull_request:
  workflow_dispatch:  # the Machine SM / sm-kicker dispatch validation runs; on main it re-seeds the baseline

permissions:
  contents: write        # push to main: update the crap-baseline release asset
  pull-requests: write   # crap:regression / crap:improved labels

# Serializes baseline updates of consecutive merges (never cancels a running update).
concurrency:
  group: quality-${{ (github.event_name == 'push' || github.event_name == 'workflow_run' || github.ref == 'refs/heads/main') && 'baseline-update' || github.run_id }}
  cancel-in-progress: false

env:
  # Threshold for functions NOT in crap-baseline.json (new or renamed code).
  CRAP_THRESHOLD: '8'
  CRAP4JS_REPO: 'IstiN/crap4js'
  CRAP4JS_REF: '83ee6201e554a91d51c298f045c5c4cb47317b6d'
  BASELINE_TAG: 'crap-baseline'
  BASELINE_ASSET: 'crap-baseline.json'

jobs:
  gate:
    # PR / dispatch on a PR head: always measure. Main-side events (push, merge-bot completion,
    # manual dispatch on main): measure only when the released baseline does not yet cover HEAD.
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    outputs:
      run: ${{ steps.g.outputs.run }}
    steps:
      - id: g
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
          EVENT: ${{ github.event_name }}
          REF: ${{ github.ref }}
          BOT_CONCLUSION: ${{ github.event.workflow_run.conclusion }}
        run: |
          main_side=false
          [ "$EVENT" = "push" ] || [ "$EVENT" = "workflow_run" ] && main_side=true
          [ "$EVENT" = "workflow_dispatch" ] && [ "$REF" = "refs/heads/main" ] && main_side=true
          if [ "$main_side" != "true" ]; then
            echo "run=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"; exit 0      # pull_request / dispatch on a PR head: always measure
          fi
          if [ "$EVENT" = "workflow_run" ] && [ "$BOT_CONCLUSION" != "success" ]; then
            echo "run=false" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"; echo "merge bot run was not successful — skip"; exit 0
          fi
          body="$(gh release view "$BASELINE_TAG" --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" --json body --jq .body 2>/dev/null || true)"
          if printf '%s' "$body" | grep -q "main@${GITHUB_SHA}"; then
            echo "run=false" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"; echo "baseline already covers ${GITHUB_SHA} — skip"
          else
            echo "run=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          fi

  crap:
    needs: gate
    if: needs.gate.outputs.run == 'true'
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 20

      - name: Install pinned tools (separate prefix — never node_modules here)
        run: |
          npm install --prefix "$RUNNER_TEMP/tools" --no-fund --no-audit \
            "github:${CRAP4JS_REPO}#${CRAP4JS_REF}" nyc@17

      - name: Instrument the tree (harness eval-loads bypass nyc's hook)
        run: |
          "$RUNNER_TEMP/tools/node_modules/.bin/nyc" instrument --cwd . . \
            "$RUNNER_TEMP/inst"
          # nyc instrument copies only .js — add the json/md/sh payloads the
          # suite reads (configs, instructions, prompts, fixtures).
          rsync -a --exclude '*.js' --exclude '.git' ./ "$RUNNER_TEMP/inst/"
          # (the factory board — and its pristine-app source guard — moved to
          # the dmtools-factory repo; nothing browser-side is text-read here anymore)
          # Tests call `git ls-files` (agentDocsCoverage): give the copied tree a throwaway
          # index of the same tracked files, without the real history.
          (cd "$RUNNER_TEMP/inst" && git init -q && git add -A -f . >/dev/null 2>&1 || true)

      - name: Run the unit suite for coverage (instrumented tree)
        # Canonical green-gate is the dmtools-java runner (pack-release test job); the node
        # harness mirrors it (file_*/cli_*/assert/network-guard parity) and must be green too,
        # so a red harness fails this job instead of being swallowed. ci/run_with_coverage.js
        # wraps the harness and dumps the Istanbul global after the run.
        run: |
          cd "$RUNNER_TEMP/inst"
          FILES="$(node -e "console.log(require('./js/unit-tests/run_all.json').params.jobParams.testFiles.join(' '))")"
          node ci/run_with_coverage.js \
            "$RUNNER_TEMP/inst/js/unit-tests/node_testRunner.js" \
            "$RUNNER_TEMP/cov/coverage-final.json" $FILES

      - name: Fetch the released baseline
        id: baseline
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
        run: |
          if gh release download "$BASELINE_TAG" --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" --pattern "$BASELINE_ASSET" \
               --dir "$RUNNER_TEMP/base" --clobber 2>/dev/null && [ -s "$RUNNER_TEMP/base/$BASELINE_ASSET" ]; then
            echo "present=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
            echo "baseline: $(node -e "const b=require('$RUNNER_TEMP/base/$BASELINE_ASSET');console.log(Object.keys(b.functions).length+' functions, max '+b.maxCrap)")"
          else
            echo "present=false" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
            echo "::notice::no $BASELINE_TAG release asset yet — bootstrapping from this run"
          fi

      - name: crap4js ratchet (compare with the released baseline)
        id: ratchet
        if: steps.baseline.outputs.present == 'true'
        run: |
          set +e
          # Redirect to a file (never a pipe): the report is ~500 KB and the verdict block comes last.
          "$RUNNER_TEMP/tools/node_modules/.bin/crap4js" . \
            --coverage "$RUNNER_TEMP/cov/coverage-final.json" \
            --threshold "${CRAP_THRESHOLD}" \
            --baseline "$RUNNER_TEMP/base/$BASELINE_ASSET" > "$RUNNER_TEMP/crap.txt"
          code=$?
          head -30 "$RUNNER_TEMP/crap.txt"
          sed -n '/^CRAP Ratchet/,$p' "$RUNNER_TEMP/crap.txt" | tee -a "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
          if grep -q '^improved ' "$RUNNER_TEMP/crap.txt"; then echo "improved=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"; fi

## Description

## Problem

The rework contract (`### Blocked (agents#827)`: a pass with open threads and no code change is treated as blocked — the leg writes `BLOCKED:` and the ticket moves to `status:Blocked`) updates only the ISSUE's status label. **No SM rule reads `status:Blocked`** — the PR keeps whatever arm it carried (`agent:rework`), and every subsequent tick re-dispatches a rework leg on a ticket the leg itself just declared blocked. Live: dmtools-dart gh-395 / PR #420, 2026-10-18 18:55Z — leg run 39156398849 concluded blocked (issue at `status:Blocked`), PR still armed, next leg would have burned until a human stripped the label manually.

## Root cause

Two parallel "blocked" vocabularies with no bridge: the JS contract writes the issue's `status:Blocked`; the SM's park vocabulary is the PR's `blocked` label (every rule carries `notLabels: [blocked]`). The post-action that moves the ticket to Blocked never touches the PR.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] When a rework/dev leg concludes BLOCKED (the `BLOCKED:` output contract), the post-action ALSO labels the linked PR `blocked` and strips `agent:rework` / `agent:review` arms from both the PR and the issue — one atomic park.
- [ ] Unblocking is symmetric: a human removing `blocked` from the PR (or moving the issue off `status:Blocked`) is enough for the standard lanes to re-admit the pair (no hidden second switch).
- [ ] Unit test: simulated blocked conclusion → PR carries `blocked`, arms gone, next tick dispatches nothing for the pair.

## Non-goals

- Auto-unblocking heuristics (a human owns the blocked state by design).

if (prLabels.indexOf(arm) === -1 && prLabels.length > 0) return; // absent — nothing to strip

```javascript
var names = (pr.labels || []).map(function (l) { return (l && l.name) || l; });
```

# Quality gate — per-function CRAP ratchet via crap4js (IstiN fork).
#
# Policy: CRAP may only DECREASE. The baseline (per-function CRAP of everything above
# CRAP_THRESHOLD) is NOT in the repository …

blocks.text:
# Quality gate — per-function CRAP ratchet via crap4js (IstiN fork).
#
# Policy: CRAP may only DECREASE. The baseline (per-function CRAP of everything above
# CRAP_THRESHOLD) is NOT in the repository — with many agents opening PRs a committed file
# conflicts constantly. It lives in a rolling GitHub release asset:
#
#   release tag  crap-baseline   (prerelease, never "latest" — agent pack consumers resolve
#                                 releases/latest, so this one must not be it)
#   asset        crap-baseline.json
#
# pull_request / workflow_dispatch (the factory SM dispatches this on PR heads): measure the
#   head and COMPARE with the released baseline. Fails when a function's CRAP grew or a new
#   function exceeds CRAP_THRESHOLD; labels crap:regression / crap:improved.
# main (push, merge-bot completion via workflow_run — the bot merges with GITHUB_TOKEN, which
#   never fires 'push' —, or manual dispatch on main): after a green measurement, ratchet the
#   released baseline DOWN (crap4js --update-baseline: min(old, now), never up, refuses on
#   regression) and upload it. The release notes carry 'main@<sha>' so repeated triggers for
#   the same HEAD are skipped. Concurrent merges are serialized by the concurrency group.
# No baseline asset yet (first run / fork): bootstrap from the measured main, no comparison.
#
# Coverage comes from the unit suite run in the same job (instrumented tree), so the
# ratchet is evaluated with the unit-test results of the head.
#
# Tool pin: IstiN/crap4js by commit SHA (fork of vabhzw17eg2qu4m9-bit/crap4js v0.15.0 +
# --baseline / --update-baseline, pipe-safe exit). Installed from GitHub — the npm 'crap4js'
# package is an unrelated third-party project.
name: Quality

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  workflow_run:
    # The merge bot merges with GITHUB_TOKEN, and GitHub suppresses workflow triggers on
    # GITHUB_TOKEN events — the push trigger above never fires for machine merges (same
    # reason agent-pack-release.yml listens to this workflow, gh-867). The bot's own run
    # completion is a normal event. Runs on every bot completion are cheap no-ops: the
    # 'gate' job skips when the baseline already covers main's HEAD.
    workflows: ['Machine Merge Bot']
    types: [completed]
  pull_request:
  workflow_dispatch:  # the Machine SM / sm-kicker dispatch validation runs; on main it re-seeds the baseline

permissions:
  contents: write        # push to main: update the crap-baseline release asset
  pull-requests: write   # crap:regression / crap:improved labels

# Serializes baseline updates of consecutive merges (never cancels a running update).
concurrency:
  group: quality-${{ (github.event_name == 'push' || github.event_name == 'workflow_run' || github.ref == 'refs/heads/main') && 'baseline-update' || github.run_id }}
  cancel-in-progress: false

env:
  # Threshold for functions NOT in crap-baseline.json (new or renamed code).
  CRAP_THRESHOLD: '8'
  CRAP4JS_REPO: 'IstiN/crap4js'
  CRAP4JS_REF: '83ee6201e554a91d51c298f045c5c4cb47317b6d'
  BASELINE_TAG: 'crap-baseline'
  BASELINE_ASSET: 'crap-baseline.json'

jobs:
  gate:
    # PR / dispatch on a PR head: always measure. Main-side events (push, merge-bot completion,
    # manual dispatch on main): measure only when the released baseline does not yet cover HEAD.
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    outputs:
      run: ${{ steps.g.outputs.run }}
    steps:
      - id: g
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
          EVENT: ${{ github.event_name }}
          REF: ${{ github.ref }}
          BOT_CONCLUSION: ${{ github.event.workflow_run.conclusion }}
        run: |
          main_side=false
          [ "$EVENT" = "push" ] || [ "$EVENT" = "workflow_run" ] && main_side=true
          [ "$EVENT" = "workflow_dispatch" ] && [ "$REF" = "refs/heads/main" ] && main_side=true
          if [ "$main_side" != "true" ]; then
            echo "run=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"; exit 0      # pull_request / dispatch on a PR head: always measure
          fi
          if [ "$EVENT" = "workflow_run" ] && [ "$BOT_CONCLUSION" != "success" ]; then
            echo "run=false" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"; echo "merge bot run was not successful — skip"; exit 0
          fi
          body="$(gh release view "$BASELINE_TAG" --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" --json body --jq .body 2>/dev/null || true)"
          if printf '%s' "$body" | grep -q "main@${GITHUB_SHA}"; then
            echo "run=false" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"; echo "baseline already covers ${GITHUB_SHA} — skip"
          else
            echo "run=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          fi

  crap:
    needs: gate
    if: needs.gate.outputs.run == 'true'
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 20

      - name: Install pinned tools (separate prefix — never node_modules here)
        run: |
          npm install --prefix "$RUNNER_TEMP/tools" --no-fund --no-audit \
            "github:${CRAP4JS_REPO}#${CRAP4JS_REF}" nyc@17

      - name: Instrument the tree (harness eval-loads bypass nyc's hook)
        run: |
          "$RUNNER_TEMP/tools/node_modules/.bin/nyc" instrument --cwd . . \
            "$RUNNER_TEMP/inst"
          # nyc instrument copies only .js — add the json/md/sh payloads the
          # suite reads (configs, instructions, prompts, fixtures).
          rsync -a --exclude '*.js' --exclude '.git' ./ "$RUNNER_TEMP/inst/"
          # (the factory board — and its pristine-app source guard — moved to
          # the dmtools-factory repo; nothing browser-side is text-read here anymore)
          # Tests call `git ls-files` (agentDocsCoverage): give the copied tree a throwaway
          # index of the same tracked files, without the real history.
          (cd "$RUNNER_TEMP/inst" && git init -q && git add -A -f . >/dev/null 2>&1 || true)

      - name: Run the unit suite for coverage (instrumented tree)
        # Canonical green-gate is the dmtools-java runner (pack-release test job); the node
        # harness mirrors it (file_*/cli_*/assert/network-guard parity) and must be green too,
        # so a red harness fails this job instead of being swallowed. ci/run_with_coverage.js
        # wraps the harness and dumps the Istanbul global after the run.
        run: |
          cd "$RUNNER_TEMP/inst"
          FILES="$(node -e "console.log(require('./js/unit-tests/run_all.json').params.jobParams.testFiles.join(' '))")"
          node ci/run_with_coverage.js \
            "$RUNNER_TEMP/inst/js/unit-tests/node_testRunner.js" \
            "$RUNNER_TEMP/cov/coverage-final.json" $FILES

      - name: Fetch the released baseline
        id: baseline
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
        run: |
          if gh release download "$BASELINE_TAG" --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" --pattern "$BASELINE_ASSET" \
               --dir "$RUNNER_TEMP/base" --clobber 2>/dev/null && [ -s "$RUNNER_TEMP/base/$BASELINE_ASSET" ]; then
            echo "present=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
            echo "baseline: $(node -e "const b=require('$RUNNER_TEMP/base/$BASELINE_ASSET');console.log(Object.keys(b.functions).length+' functions, max '+b.maxCrap)")"
          else
            echo "present=false" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
            echo "::notice::no $BASELINE_TAG release asset yet — bootstrapping from this run"
          fi

      - name: crap4js ratchet (compare with the released baseline)
        id: ratchet
        if: steps.baseline.outputs.present == 'true'
        run: |
          set +e
          # Redirect to a file (never a pipe): the report is ~500 KB and the verdict block comes last.
          "$RUNNER_TEMP/tools/node_modules/.bin/crap4js" . \
            --coverage "$RUNNER_TEMP/cov/coverage-final.json" \
            --threshold "${CRAP_THRESHOLD}" \
            --baseline "$RUNNER_TEMP/base/$BASELINE_ASSET" > "$RUNNER_TEMP/crap.txt"
          code=$?
          head -30 "$RUNNER_TEMP/crap.txt"
          sed -n '/^CRAP Ratchet/,$p' "$RUNNER_TEMP/crap.txt" | tee -a "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
          if grep -q '^improved ' "$RUNNER_TEMP/crap.txt"; then echo "improved=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"; fi

- `stripArmFromPr(scm, pr, arm)` — the per-arm removeLabel try/catch
- `stripArmFromIssue(tracker, ticketKey, arm)` — the tracker-side loop

Each of those is ~CC 3–4. This also fixes the second blocker (label-shape guard) at the same time, since the strip helper is where the normalization belongs.

### Thread 2 — `js/pushReworkChanges.js` line 1519

**dmtools-factory-bot** (2026-10-18):
🚨 **BLOCKING: PR-side arms are never stripped in production — `indexOf` against REST `{name}` label objects always misses, then the guard early-returns**

The `pr` object here comes from `requirePrForTicket` → `findPRForTicket` → `scm.listPrs('open')`, i.e. the raw GitHub REST list payload, where labels are **`[{name: 'agent:rework'}, …]` objects, not strings**. The codebase documents and handles this everywhere it touches raw PR labels:

- `js/sm/sources/githubSource.js:110` — `prLabels(p)` maps `(l && l.name) || l` for exactly this reason
- `prHasApproved` (this file, ~line 131) — "REST labels: [{name}] objects or strings"
- `mergeQueueBodyLabelPresent` (`js/common/pullRequest.js:191`) — same normalization

```javascript
if (prLabels.indexOf(arm) === -1 && prLabels.length > 0) return; // absent — nothing to strip
```

Result: AC1's "strips `agent:rework` / `agent:review` arms from **both** the PR and the issue" silently degrades to issue-only. The `blocked` label add does freeze the pair (the loop stops), but the PR keeps its stale arm — precisely the state the PR description warns about ("stripped arms mean no stale arm fires on re-admission" — false for the PR side).

Note the issue-side loop below has no such guard at all — it just best-effort `removeLabel`s. The simplest correct fix is to drop the guard and do the same on the PR side (a 404 on an absent label is already tolerated by the try/catch), or normalize first:

```javascript
var names = (pr.labels || []).map(function (l) { return (l && l.name) || l; });
```

The new unit test mocks `labels: ['agent:rework', 'agent:review']` as plain strings, which is why the suite is green while production behavior differs — see the companion comment on the test mock.

# Quality gate — per-function CRAP ratchet via crap4js (IstiN fork).
#
# Policy: CRAP may only DECREASE. The baseline (per-function CRAP of everything above
# CRAP_THRESHOLD) is NOT in the repository …

blocks.text:
# Quality gate — per-function CRAP ratchet via crap4js (IstiN fork).
#
# Policy: CRAP may only DECREASE. The baseline (per-function CRAP of everything above
# CRAP_THRESHOLD) is NOT in the repository — with many agents opening PRs a committed file
# conflicts constantly. It lives in a rolling GitHub release asset:
#
#   release tag  crap-baseline   (prerelease, never "latest" — agent pack consumers resolve
#                                 releases/latest, so this one must not be it)
#   asset        crap-baseline.json
#
# pull_request / workflow_dispatch (the factory SM dispatches this on PR heads): measure the
#   head and COMPARE with the released baseline. Fails when a function's CRAP grew or a new
#   function exceeds CRAP_THRESHOLD; labels crap:regression / crap:improved.
# main (push, merge-bot completion via workflow_run — the bot merges with GITHUB_TOKEN, which
#   never fires 'push' —, or manual dispatch on main): after a green measurement, ratchet the
#   released baseline DOWN (crap4js --update-baseline: min(old, now), never up, refuses on
#   regression) and upload it. The release notes carry 'main@<sha>' so repeated triggers for
#   the same HEAD are skipped. Concurrent merges are serialized by the concurrency group.
# No baseline asset yet (first run / fork): bootstrap from the measured main, no comparison.
#
# Coverage comes from the unit suite run in the same job (instrumented tree), so the
# ratchet is evaluated with the unit-test results of the head.
#
# Tool pin: IstiN/crap4js by commit SHA (fork of vabhzw17eg2qu4m9-bit/crap4js v0.15.0 +
# --baseline / --update-baseline, pipe-safe exit). Installed from GitHub — the npm 'crap4js'
# package is an unrelated third-party project.
name: Quality

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  workflow_run:
    # The merge bot merges with GITHUB_TOKEN, and GitHub suppresses workflow triggers on
    # GITHUB_TOKEN events — the push trigger above never fires for machine merges (same
    # reason agent-pack-release.yml listens to this workflow, gh-867). The bot's own run
    # completion is a normal event. Runs on every bot completion are cheap no-ops: the
    # 'gate' job skips when the baseline already covers main's HEAD.
    workflows: ['Machine Merge Bot']
    types: [completed]
  pull_request:
  workflow_dispatch:  # the Machine SM / sm-kicker dispatch validation runs; on main it re-seeds the baseline

permissions:
  contents: write        # push to main: update the crap-baseline release asset
  pull-requests: write   # crap:regression / crap:improved labels

# Serializes baseline updates of consecutive merges (never cancels a running update).
concurrency:
  group: quality-${{ (github.event_name == 'push' || github.event_name == 'workflow_run' || github.ref == 'refs/heads/main') && 'baseline-update' || github.run_id }}
  cancel-in-progress: false

env:
  # Threshold for functions NOT in crap-baseline.json (new or renamed code).
  CRAP_THRESHOLD: '8'
  CRAP4JS_REPO: 'IstiN/crap4js'
  CRAP4JS_REF: '83ee6201e554a91d51c298f045c5c4cb47317b6d'
  BASELINE_TAG: 'crap-baseline'
  BASELINE_ASSET: 'crap-baseline.json'

jobs:
  gate:
    # PR / dispatch on a PR head: always measure. Main-side events (push, merge-bot completion,
    # manual dispatch on main): measure only when the released baseline does not yet cover HEAD.
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    outputs:
      run: ${{ steps.g.outputs.run }}
    steps:
      - id: g
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
          EVENT: ${{ github.event_name }}
          REF: ${{ github.ref }}
          BOT_CONCLUSION: ${{ github.event.workflow_run.conclusion }}
        run: |
          main_side=false
          [ "$EVENT" = "push" ] || [ "$EVENT" = "workflow_run" ] && main_side=true
          [ "$EVENT" = "workflow_dispatch" ] && [ "$REF" = "refs/heads/main" ] && main_side=true
          if [ "$main_side" != "true" ]; then
            echo "run=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"; exit 0      # pull_request / dispatch on a PR head: always measure
          fi
          if [ "$EVENT" = "workflow_run" ] && [ "$BOT_CONCLUSION" != "success" ]; then
            echo "run=false" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"; echo "merge bot run was not successful — skip"; exit 0
          fi
          body="$(gh release view "$BASELINE_TAG" --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" --json body --jq .body 2>/dev/null || true)"
          if printf '%s' "$body" | grep -q "main@${GITHUB_SHA}"; then
            echo "run=false" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"; echo "baseline already covers ${GITHUB_SHA} — skip"
          else
            echo "run=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          fi

  crap:
    needs: gate
    if: needs.gate.outputs.run == 'true'
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 20

      - name: Install pinned tools (separate prefix — never node_modules here)
        run: |
          npm install --prefix "$RUNNER_TEMP/tools" --no-fund --no-audit \
            "github:${CRAP4JS_REPO}#${CRAP4JS_REF}" nyc@17

      - name: Instrument the tree (harness eval-loads bypass nyc's hook)
        run: |
          "$RUNNER_TEMP/tools/node_modules/.bin/nyc" instrument --cwd . . \
            "$RUNNER_TEMP/inst"
          # nyc instrument copies only .js — add the json/md/sh payloads the
          # suite reads (configs, instructions, prompts, fixtures).
          rsync -a --exclude '*.js' --exclude '.git' ./ "$RUNNER_TEMP/inst/"
          # (the factory board — and its pristine-app source guard — moved to
          # the dmtools-factory repo; nothing browser-side is text-read here anymore)
          # Tests call `git ls-files` (agentDocsCoverage): give the copied tree a throwaway
          # index of the same tracked files, without the real history.
          (cd "$RUNNER_TEMP/inst" && git init -q && git add -A -f . >/dev/null 2>&1 || true)

      - name: Run the unit suite for coverage (instrumented tree)
        # Canonical green-gate is the dmtools-java runner (pack-release test job); the node
        # harness mirrors it (file_*/cli_*/assert/network-guard parity) and must be green too,
        # so a red harness fails this job instead of being swallowed. ci/run_with_coverage.js
        # wraps the harness and dumps the Istanbul global after the run.
        run: |
          cd "$RUNNER_TEMP/inst"
          FILES="$(node -e "console.log(require('./js/unit-tests/run_all.json').params.jobParams.testFiles.join(' '))")"
          node ci/run_with_coverage.js \
            "$RUNNER_TEMP/inst/js/unit-tests/node_testRunner.js" \
            "$RUNNER_TEMP/cov/coverage-final.json" $FILES

      - name: Fetch the released baseline
        id: baseline
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
        run: |
          if gh release download "$BASELINE_TAG" --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" --pattern "$BASELINE_ASSET" \
               --dir "$RUNNER_TEMP/base" --clobber 2>/dev/null && [ -s "$RUNNER_TEMP/base/$BASELINE_ASSET" ]; then
            echo "present=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
            echo "baseline: $(node -e "const b=require('$RUNNER_TEMP/base/$BASELINE_ASSET');console.log(Object.keys(b.functions).length+' functions, max '+b.maxCrap)")"
          else
            echo "present=false" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
            echo "::notice::no $BASELINE_TAG release asset yet — bootstrapping from this run"
          fi

      - name: crap4js ratchet (compare with the released baseline)
        id: ratchet
        if: steps.baseline.outputs.present == 'true'
        run: |
          set +e
          # Redirect to a file (never a pipe): the report is ~500 KB and the verdict block comes last.
          "$RUNNER_TEMP/tools/node_modules/.bin/crap4js" . \
            --coverage "$RUNNER_TEMP/cov/coverage-final.json" \
            --threshold "${CRAP_THRESHOLD}" \
            --baseline "$RUNNER_TEMP/base/$BASELINE_ASSET" > "$RUNNER_TEMP/crap.txt"
          code=$?
          head -30 "$RUNNER_TEMP/crap.txt"
          sed -n '/^CRAP Ratchet/,$p' "$RUNNER_TEMP/crap.txt" | tee -a "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
          if grep -q '^improved ' "$RUNNER_TEMP/crap.txt"; then echo "improved=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"; fi

var names = (pr.labels || []).map(function (l) { return (l && l.name) || l; });

blocks.text:
# Quality gate — per-function CRAP ratchet via crap4js (IstiN fork).
#
# Policy: CRAP may only DECREASE. The baseline (per-function CRAP of everything above
# CRAP_THRESHOLD) is NOT in the repository — with many agents opening PRs a committed file
# conflicts constantly. It lives in a rolling GitHub release asset:
#
#   release tag  crap-baseline   (prerelease, never "latest" — agent pack consumers resolve
#                                 releases/latest, so this one must not be it)
#   asset        crap-baseline.json
#
# pull_request / workflow_dispatch (the factory SM dispatches this on PR heads): measure the
#   head and COMPARE with the released baseline. Fails when a function's CRAP grew or a new
#   function exceeds CRAP_THRESHOLD; labels crap:regression / crap:improved.
# main (push, merge-bot completion via workflow_run — the bot merges with GITHUB_TOKEN, which
#   never fires 'push' —, or manual dispatch on main): after a green measurement, ratchet the
#   released baseline DOWN (crap4js --update-baseline: min(old, now), never up, refuses on
#   regression) and upload it. The release notes carry 'main@<sha>' so repeated triggers for
#   the same HEAD are skipped. Concurrent merges are serialized by the concurrency group.
# No baseline asset yet (first run / fork): bootstrap from the measured main, no comparison.
#
# Coverage comes from the unit suite run in the same job (instrumented tree), so the
# ratchet is evaluated with the unit-test results of the head.
#
# Tool pin: IstiN/crap4js by commit SHA (fork of vabhzw17eg2qu4m9-bit/crap4js v0.15.0 +
# --baseline / --update-baseline, pipe-safe exit). Installed from GitHub — the npm 'crap4js'
# package is an unrelated third-party project.
name: Quality

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  workflow_run:
    # The merge bot merges with GITHUB_TOKEN, and GitHub suppresses workflow triggers on
    # GITHUB_TOKEN events — the push trigger above never fires for machine merges (same
    # reason agent-pack-release.yml listens to this workflow, gh-867). The bot's own run
    # completion is a normal event. Runs on every bot completion are cheap no-ops: the
    # 'gate' job skips when the baseline already covers main's HEAD.
    workflows: ['Machine Merge Bot']
    types: [completed]
  pull_request:
  workflow_dispatch:  # the Machine SM / sm-kicker dispatch validation runs; on main it re-seeds the baseline

permissions:
  contents: write        # push to main: update the crap-baseline release asset
  pull-requests: write   # crap:regression / crap:improved labels

# Serializes baseline updates of consecutive merges (never cancels a running update).
concurrency:
  group: quality-${{ (github.event_name == 'push' || github.event_name == 'workflow_run' || github.ref == 'refs/heads/main') && 'baseline-update' || github.run_id }}
  cancel-in-progress: false

env:
  # Threshold for functions NOT in crap-baseline.json (new or renamed code).
  CRAP_THRESHOLD: '8'
  CRAP4JS_REPO: 'IstiN/crap4js'
  CRAP4JS_REF: '83ee6201e554a91d51c298f045c5c4cb47317b6d'
  BASELINE_TAG: 'crap-baseline'
  BASELINE_ASSET: 'crap-baseline.json'

jobs:
  gate:
    # PR / dispatch on a PR head: always measure. Main-side events (push, merge-bot completion,
    # manual dispatch on main): measure only when the released baseline does not yet cover HEAD.
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    outputs:
      run: ${{ steps.g.outputs.run }}
    steps:
      - id: g
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
          EVENT: ${{ github.event_name }}
          REF: ${{ github.ref }}
          BOT_CONCLUSION: ${{ github.event.workflow_run.conclusion }}
        run: |
          main_side=false
          [ "$EVENT" = "push" ] || [ "$EVENT" = "workflow_run" ] && main_side=true
          [ "$EVENT" = "workflow_dispatch" ] && [ "$REF" = "refs/heads/main" ] && main_side=true
          if [ "$main_side" != "true" ]; then
            echo "run=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"; exit 0      # pull_request / dispatch on a PR head: always measure
          fi
          if [ "$EVENT" = "workflow_run" ] && [ "$BOT_CONCLUSION" != "success" ]; then
            echo "run=false" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"; echo "merge bot run was not successful — skip"; exit 0
          fi
          body="$(gh release view "$BASELINE_TAG" --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" --json body --jq .body 2>/dev/null || true)"
          if printf '%s' "$body" | grep -q "main@${GITHUB_SHA}"; then
            echo "run=false" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"; echo "baseline already covers ${GITHUB_SHA} — skip"
          else
            echo "run=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          fi

  crap:
    needs: gate
    if: needs.gate.outputs.run == 'true'
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 20

      - name: Install pinned tools (separate prefix — never node_modules here)
        run: |
          npm install --prefix "$RUNNER_TEMP/tools" --no-fund --no-audit \
            "github:${CRAP4JS_REPO}#${CRAP4JS_REF}" nyc@17

      - name: Instrument the tree (harness eval-loads bypass nyc's hook)
        run: |
          "$RUNNER_TEMP/tools/node_modules/.bin/nyc" instrument --cwd . . \
            "$RUNNER_TEMP/inst"
          # nyc instrument copies only .js — add the json/md/sh payloads the
          # suite reads (configs, instructions, prompts, fixtures).
          rsync -a --exclude '*.js' --exclude '.git' ./ "$RUNNER_TEMP/inst/"
          # (the factory board — and its pristine-app source guard — moved to
          # the dmtools-factory repo; nothing browser-side is text-read here anymore)
          # Tests call `git ls-files` (agentDocsCoverage): give the copied tree a throwaway
          # index of the same tracked files, without the real history.
          (cd "$RUNNER_TEMP/inst" && git init -q && git add -A -f . >/dev/null 2>&1 || true)

      - name: Run the unit suite for coverage (instrumented tree)
        # Canonical green-gate is the dmtools-java runner (pack-release test job); the node
        # harness mirrors it (file_*/cli_*/assert/network-guard parity) and must be green too,
        # so a red harness fails this job instead of being swallowed. ci/run_with_coverage.js
        # wraps the harness and dumps the Istanbul global after the run.
        run: |
          cd "$RUNNER_TEMP/inst"
          FILES="$(node -e "console.log(require('./js/unit-tests/run_all.json').params.jobParams.testFiles.join(' '))")"
          node ci/run_with_coverage.js \
            "$RUNNER_TEMP/inst/js/unit-tests/node_testRunner.js" \
            "$RUNNER_TEMP/cov/coverage-final.json" $FILES

      - name: Fetch the released baseline
        id: baseline
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
        run: |
          if gh release download "$BASELINE_TAG" --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" --pattern "$BASELINE_ASSET" \
               --dir "$RUNNER_TEMP/base" --clobber 2>/dev/null && [ -s "$RUNNER_TEMP/base/$BASELINE_ASSET" ]; then
            echo "present=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
            echo "baseline: $(node -e "const b=require('$RUNNER_TEMP/base/$BASELINE_ASSET');console.log(Object.keys(b.functions).length+' functions, max '+b.maxCrap)")"
          else
            echo "present=false" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
            echo "::notice::no $BASELINE_TAG release asset yet — bootstrapping from this run"
          fi

      - name: crap4js ratchet (compare with the released baseline)
        id: ratchet
        if: steps.baseline.outputs.present == 'true'
        run: |
          set +e
          # Redirect to a file (never a pipe): the report is ~500 KB and the verdict block comes last.
          "$RUNNER_TEMP/tools/node_modules/.bin/crap4js" . \
            --coverage "$RUNNER_TEMP/cov/coverage-final.json" \
            --threshold "${CRAP_THRESHOLD}" \
            --baseline "$RUNNER_TEMP/base/$BASELINE_ASSET" > "$RUNNER_TEMP/crap.txt"
          code=$?
          head -30 "$RUNNER_TEMP/crap.txt"
          sed -n '/^CRAP Ratchet/,$p' "$RUNNER_TEMP/crap.txt" | tee -a "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
          if grep -q '^improved ' "$RUNNER_TEMP/crap.txt"; then echo "improved=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"; fi
          e…

# Quality gate — per-function CRAP ratchet via crap4js (IstiN fork).
#
# Policy: CRAP may only DECREASE. The baseline (per-function CRAP of everything above
# CRAP_THRESHOLD) is NOT in the repository …

blocks.text:
# Quality gate — per-function CRAP ratchet via crap4js (IstiN fork).
#
# Policy: CRAP may only DECREASE. The baseline (per-function CRAP of everything above
# CRAP_THRESHOLD) is NOT in the repository — with many agents opening PRs a committed file
# conflicts constantly. It lives in a rolling GitHub release asset:
#
#   release tag  crap-baseline   (prerelease, never "latest" — agent pack consumers resolve
#                                 releases/latest, so this one must not be it)
#   asset        crap-baseline.json
#
# pull_request / workflow_dispatch (the factory SM dispatches this on PR heads): measure the
#   head and COMPARE with the released baseline. Fails when a function's CRAP grew or a new
#   function exceeds CRAP_THRESHOLD; labels crap:regression / crap:improved.
# main (push, merge-bot completion via workflow_run — the bot merges with GITHUB_TOKEN, which
#   never fires 'push' —, or manual dispatch on main): after a green measurement, ratchet the
#   released baseline DOWN (crap4js --update-baseline: min(old, now), never up, refuses on
#   regression) and upload it. The release notes carry 'main@<sha>' so repeated triggers for
#   the same HEAD are skipped. Concurrent merges are serialized by the concurrency group.
# No baseline asset yet (first run / fork): bootstrap from the measured main, no comparison.
#
# Coverage comes from the unit suite run in the same job (instrumented tree), so the
# ratchet is evaluated with the unit-test results of the head.
#
# Tool pin: IstiN/crap4js by commit SHA (fork of vabhzw17eg2qu4m9-bit/crap4js v0.15.0 +
# --baseline / --update-baseline, pipe-safe exit). Installed from GitHub — the npm 'crap4js'
# package is an unrelated third-party project.
name: Quality

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  workflow_run:
    # The merge bot merges with GITHUB_TOKEN, and GitHub suppresses workflow triggers on
    # GITHUB_TOKEN events — the push trigger above never fires for machine merges (same
    # reason agent-pack-release.yml listens to this workflow, gh-867). The bot's own run
    # completion is a normal event. Runs on every bot completion are cheap no-ops: the
    # 'gate' job skips when the baseline already covers main's HEAD.
    workflows: ['Machine Merge Bot']
    types: [completed]
  pull_request:
  workflow_dispatch:  # the Machine SM / sm-kicker dispatch validation runs; on main it re-seeds the baseline

permissions:
  contents: write        # push to main: update the crap-baseline release asset
  pull-requests: write   # crap:regression / crap:improved labels

# Serializes baseline updates of consecutive merges (never cancels a running update).
concurrency:
  group: quality-${{ (github.event_name == 'push' || github.event_name == 'workflow_run' || github.ref == 'refs/heads/main') && 'baseline-update' || github.run_id }}
  cancel-in-progress: false

env:
  # Threshold for functions NOT in crap-baseline.json (new or renamed code).
  CRAP_THRESHOLD: '8'
  CRAP4JS_REPO: 'IstiN/crap4js'
  CRAP4JS_REF: '83ee6201e554a91d51c298f045c5c4cb47317b6d'
  BASELINE_TAG: 'crap-baseline'
  BASELINE_ASSET: 'crap-baseline.json'

jobs:
  gate:
    # PR / dispatch on a PR head: always measure. Main-side events (push, merge-bot completion,
    # manual dispatch on main): measure only when the released baseline does not yet cover HEAD.
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    outputs:
      run: ${{ steps.g.outputs.run }}
    steps:
      - id: g
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
          EVENT: ${{ github.event_name }}
          REF: ${{ github.ref }}
          BOT_CONCLUSION: ${{ github.event.workflow_run.conclusion }}
        run: |
          main_side=false
          [ "$EVENT" = "push" ] || [ "$EVENT" = "workflow_run" ] && main_side=true
          [ "$EVENT" = "workflow_dispatch" ] && [ "$REF" = "refs/heads/main" ] && main_side=true
          if [ "$main_side" != "true" ]; then
            echo "run=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"; exit 0      # pull_request / dispatch on a PR head: always measure
          fi
          if [ "$EVENT" = "workflow_run" ] && [ "$BOT_CONCLUSION" != "success" ]; then
            echo "run=false" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"; echo "merge bot run was not successful — skip"; exit 0
          fi
          body="$(gh release view "$BASELINE_TAG" --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" --json body --jq .body 2>/dev/null || true)"
          if printf '%s' "$body" | grep -q "main@${GITHUB_SHA}"; then
            echo "run=false" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"; echo "baseline already covers ${GITHUB_SHA} — skip"
          else
            echo "run=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          fi

  crap:
    needs: gate
    if: needs.gate.outputs.run == 'true'
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 20

      - name: Install pinned tools (separate prefix — never node_modules here)
        run: |
          npm install --prefix "$RUNNER_TEMP/tools" --no-fund --no-audit \
            "github:${CRAP4JS_REPO}#${CRAP4JS_REF}" nyc@17

      - name: Instrument the tree (harness eval-loads bypass nyc's hook)
        run: |
          "$RUNNER_TEMP/tools/node_modules/.bin/nyc" instrument --cwd . . \
            "$RUNNER_TEMP/inst"
          # nyc instrument copies only .js — add the json/md/sh payloads the
          # suite reads (configs, instructions, prompts, fixtures).
          rsync -a --exclude '*.js' --exclude '.git' ./ "$RUNNER_TEMP/inst/"
          # (the factory board — and its pristine-app source guard — moved to
          # the dmtools-factory repo; nothing browser-side is text-read here anymore)
          # Tests call `git ls-files` (agentDocsCoverage): give the copied tree a throwaway
          # index of the same tracked files, without the real history.
          (cd "$RUNNER_TEMP/inst" && git init -q && git add -A -f . >/dev/null 2>&1 || true)

      - name: Run the unit suite for coverage (instrumented tree)
        # Canonical green-gate is the dmtools-java runner (pack-release test job); the node
        # harness mirrors it (file_*/cli_*/assert/network-guard parity) and must be green too,
        # so a red harness fails this job instead of being swallowed. ci/run_with_coverage.js
        # wraps the harness and dumps the Istanbul global after the run.
        run: |
          cd "$RUNNER_TEMP/inst"
          FILES="$(node -e "console.log(require('./js/unit-tests/run_all.json').params.jobParams.testFiles.join(' '))")"
          node ci/run_with_coverage.js \
            "$RUNNER_TEMP/inst/js/unit-tests/node_testRunner.js" \
            "$RUNNER_TEMP/cov/coverage-final.json" $FILES

      - name: Fetch the released baseline
        id: baseline
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
        run: |
          if gh release download "$BASELINE_TAG" --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" --pattern "$BASELINE_ASSET" \
               --dir "$RUNNER_TEMP/base" --clobber 2>/dev/null && [ -s "$RUNNER_TEMP/base/$BASELINE_ASSET" ]; then
            echo "present=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
            echo "baseline: $(node -e "const b=require('$RUNNER_TEMP/base/$BASELINE_ASSET');console.log(Object.keys(b.functions).length+' functions, max '+b.maxCrap)")"
          else
            echo "present=false" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
            echo "::notice::no $BASELINE_TAG release asset yet — bootstrapping from this run"
          fi

      - name: crap4js ratchet (compare with the released baseline)
        id: ratchet
        if: steps.baseline.outputs.present == 'true'
        run: |
          set +e
          # Redirect to a file (never a pipe): the report is ~500 KB and the verdict block comes last.
          "$RUNNER_TEMP/tools/node_modules/.bin/crap4js" . \
            --coverage "$RUNNER_TEMP/cov/coverage-final.json" \
            --threshold "${CRAP_THRESHOLD}" \
            --baseline "$RUNNER_TEMP/base/$BASELINE_ASSET" > "$RUNNER_TEMP/crap.txt"
          code=$?
          head -30 "$RUNNER_TEMP/crap.txt"
          sed -n '/^CRAP Ratchet/,$p' "$RUNNER_TEMP/crap.txt" | tee -a "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
          if grep -q '^improved ' "$RUNNER_TEMP/crap.txt"; then echo "improved=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"; fi

# Quality gate — per-function CRAP ratchet via crap4js (IstiN fork).
#
# Policy: CRAP may only DECREASE. The baseline (per-function CRAP of everything above
# CRAP_THRESHOLD) is NOT in the repository …

blocks.text:
# Quality gate — per-function CRAP ratchet via crap4js (IstiN fork).
#
# Policy: CRAP may only DECREASE. The baseline (per-function CRAP of everything above
# CRAP_THRESHOLD) is NOT in the repository — with many agents opening PRs a committed file
# conflicts constantly. It lives in a rolling GitHub release asset:
#
#   release tag  crap-baseline   (prerelease, never "latest" — agent pack consumers resolve
#                                 releases/latest, so this one must not be it)
#   asset        crap-baseline.json
#
# pull_request / workflow_dispatch (the factory SM dispatches this on PR heads): measure the
#   head and COMPARE with the released baseline. Fails when a function's CRAP grew or a new
#   function exceeds CRAP_THRESHOLD; labels crap:regression / crap:improved.
# main (push, merge-bot completion via workflow_run — the bot merges with GITHUB_TOKEN, which
#   never fires 'push' —, or manual dispatch on main): after a green measurement, ratchet the
#   released baseline DOWN (crap4js --update-baseline: min(old, now), never up, refuses on
#   regression) and upload it. The release notes carry 'main@<sha>' so repeated triggers for
#   the same HEAD are skipped. Concurrent merges are serialized by the concurrency group.
# No baseline asset yet (first run / fork): bootstrap from the measured main, no comparison.
#
# Coverage comes from the unit suite run in the same job (instrumented tree), so the
# ratchet is evaluated with the unit-test results of the head.
#
# Tool pin: IstiN/crap4js by commit SHA (fork of vabhzw17eg2qu4m9-bit/crap4js v0.15.0 +
# --baseline / --update-baseline, pipe-safe exit). Installed from GitHub — the npm 'crap4js'
# package is an unrelated third-party project.
name: Quality

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  workflow_run:
    # The merge bot merges with GITHUB_TOKEN, and GitHub suppresses workflow triggers on
    # GITHUB_TOKEN events — the push trigger above never fires for machine merges (same
    # reason agent-pack-release.yml listens to this workflow, gh-867). The bot's own run
    # completion is a normal event. Runs on every bot completion are cheap no-ops: the
    # 'gate' job skips when the baseline already covers main's HEAD.
    workflows: ['Machine Merge Bot']
    types: [completed]
  pull_request:
  workflow_dispatch:  # the Machine SM / sm-kicker dispatch validation runs; on main it re-seeds the baseline

permissions:
  contents: write        # push to main: update the crap-baseline release asset
  pull-requests: write   # crap:regression / crap:improved labels

# Serializes baseline updates of consecutive merges (never cancels a running update).
concurrency:
  group: quality-${{ (github.event_name == 'push' || github.event_name == 'workflow_run' || github.ref == 'refs/heads/main') && 'baseline-update' || github.run_id }}
  cancel-in-progress: false

env:
  # Threshold for functions NOT in crap-baseline.json (new or renamed code).
  CRAP_THRESHOLD: '8'
  CRAP4JS_REPO: 'IstiN/crap4js'
  CRAP4JS_REF: '83ee6201e554a91d51c298f045c5c4cb47317b6d'
  BASELINE_TAG: 'crap-baseline'
  BASELINE_ASSET: 'crap-baseline.json'

jobs:
  gate:
    # PR / dispatch on a PR head: always measure. Main-side events (push, merge-bot completion,
    # manual dispatch on main): measure only when the released baseline does not yet cover HEAD.
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    outputs:
      run: ${{ steps.g.outputs.run }}
    steps:
      - id: g
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
          EVENT: ${{ github.event_name }}
          REF: ${{ github.ref }}
          BOT_CONCLUSION: ${{ github.event.workflow_run.conclusion }}
        run: |
          main_side=false
          [ "$EVENT" = "push" ] || [ "$EVENT" = "workflow_run" ] && main_side=true
          [ "$EVENT" = "workflow_dispatch" ] && [ "$REF" = "refs/heads/main" ] && main_side=true
          if [ "$main_side" != "true" ]; then
            echo "run=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"; exit 0      # pull_request / dispatch on a PR head: always measure
          fi
          if [ "$EVENT" = "workflow_run" ] && [ "$BOT_CONCLUSION" != "success" ]; then
            echo "run=false" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"; echo "merge bot run was not successful — skip"; exit 0
          fi
          body="$(gh release view "$BASELINE_TAG" --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" --json body --jq .body 2>/dev/null || true)"
          if printf '%s' "$body" | grep -q "main@${GITHUB_SHA}"; then
            echo "run=false" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"; echo "baseline already covers ${GITHUB_SHA} — skip"
          else
            echo "run=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          fi

  crap:
    needs: gate
    if: needs.gate.outputs.run == 'true'
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 20

      - name: Install pinned tools (separate prefix — never node_modules here)
        run: |
          npm install --prefix "$RUNNER_TEMP/tools" --no-fund --no-audit \
            "github:${CRAP4JS_REPO}#${CRAP4JS_REF}" nyc@17

      - name: Instrument the tree (harness eval-loads bypass nyc's hook)
        run: |
          "$RUNNER_TEMP/tools/node_modules/.bin/nyc" instrument --cwd . . \
            "$RUNNER_TEMP/inst"
          # nyc instrument copies only .js — add the json/md/sh payloads the
          # suite reads (configs, instructions, prompts, fixtures).
          rsync -a --exclude '*.js' --exclude '.git' ./ "$RUNNER_TEMP/inst/"
          # (the factory board — and its pristine-app source guard — moved to
          # the dmtools-factory repo; nothing browser-side is text-read here anymore)
          # Tests call `git ls-files` (agentDocsCoverage): give the copied tree a throwaway
          # index of the same tracked files, without the real history.
          (cd "$RUNNER_TEMP/inst" && git init -q && git add -A -f . >/dev/null 2>&1 || true)

      - name: Run the unit suite for coverage (instrumented tree)
        # Canonical green-gate is the dmtools-java runner (pack-release test job); the node
        # harness mirrors it (file_*/cli_*/assert/network-guard parity) and must be green too,
        # so a red harness fails this job instead of being swallowed. ci/run_with_coverage.js
        # wraps the harness and dumps the Istanbul global after the run.
        run: |
          cd "$RUNNER_TEMP/inst"
          FILES="$(node -e "console.log(require('./js/unit-tests/run_all.json').params.jobParams.testFiles.join(' '))")"
          node ci/run_with_coverage.js \
            "$RUNNER_TEMP/inst/js/unit-tests/node_testRunner.js" \
            "$RUNNER_TEMP/cov/coverage-final.json" $FILES

      - name: Fetch the released baseline
        id: baseline
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
        run: |
          if gh release download "$BASELINE_TAG" --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" --pattern "$BASELINE_ASSET" \
               --dir "$RUNNER_TEMP/base" --clobber 2>/dev/null && [ -s "$RUNNER_TEMP/base/$BASELINE_ASSET" ]; then
            echo "present=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
            echo "baseline: $(node -e "const b=require('$RUNNER_TEMP/base/$BASELINE_ASSET');console.log(Object.keys(b.functions).length+' functions, max '+b.maxCrap)")"
          else
            echo "present=false" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
            echo "::notice::no $BASELINE_TAG release asset yet — bootstrapping from this run"
          fi

      - name: crap4js ratchet (compare with the released baseline)
        id: ratchet
        if: steps.baseline.outputs.present == 'true'
        run: |
          set +e
          # Redirect to a file (never a pipe): the report is ~500 KB and the verdict block comes last.
          "$RUNNER_TEMP/tools/node_modules/.bin/crap4js" . \
            --coverage "$RUNNER_TEMP/cov/coverage-final.json" \
            --threshold "${CRAP_THRESHOLD}" \
            --baseline "$RUNNER_TEMP/base/$BASELINE_ASSET" > "$RUNNER_TEMP/crap.txt"
          code=$?
          head -30 "$RUNNER_TEMP/crap.txt"
          sed -n '/^CRAP Ratchet/,$p' "$RUNNER_TEMP/crap.txt" | tee -a "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
          if grep -q '^improved ' "$RUNNER_TEMP/crap.txt"; then echo "improved=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"; fi
          e…

## Issues/Notes

- **CI failure (Quality / crap)**: `parkBlockedPr` measured CC 13 / CRAP 14.6 > `CRAP_THRESHOLD: 8` — CRAP is bounded below by CC (`CRAP = CC²·(1−cov)² + CC`), so no amount of added coverage could bring it under; only lowering the cyclomatic complexity works. Fixed by the gh-957 CRAP-split pattern.
- **PR-side arms never stripped in production**: `prLabels.indexOf(arm)` ran against raw GitHub REST `listPrs` payloads where labels are `[{name}]` objects, so it always missed and the `prLabels.length > 0` guard early-returned — AC1 silently degraded to issue-only stripping.
- **Test mock masked the production shape**: the gh-1060 suite mocked PR labels as plain strings, which is why the suite was green while production behaved differently.

## Approach

1. **CRAP split (thread 1)** — `parkBlockedPr` decomposed into small single-responsibility helpers following the existing `gh-957 CRAP split` pattern right below it in the same file:
   - `labelPrBlocked(scm, pr)` — the `blocked` addLabel try/catch (the SM park vocabulary).
   - `stripArmFromPr(scm, pr, arm)` — per-arm removeLabel try/catch, and the home of the label normalization.
   - `stripArmFromIssue(tracker, ticketKey, arm)` — the tracker-side best-effort removeLabel.
   - `parkBlockedPr` is now a thin orchestrator (guard + two loops); each helper is ~CC 2–3, so every new function stays well under `CRAP_THRESHOLD: 8`.
2. **Label-shape fix (thread 2)** — `stripArmFromPr` normalizes `pr.labels` with the codebase-established `(l && l.name) || l` mapping (same as `githubSource.prLabels` and `prHasApproved`), and the faulty `indexOf`-based early-return guard is gone: when the PR carries labels at all, the arm is stripped unconditionally — exactly like the guard-free issue-side loop. A 404 on an absent label is already tolerated by the try/catch.
3. **Test mock (thread 3)** — the gh-1060 suite's `listPrs` mock now uses the production REST shape `labels: [{ name: 'agent:rework' }, { name: 'agent:review' }]`, matching `bug_done_and_test_pr_merge.test.js` and the githubSource suites. RED→GREEN verified: with the object-shape mock the suite **failed** against the old code (`prLabelsRemoved: []` — the exact production bug) and passes with the fix.

- `js/pushReworkChanges.js` — `parkBlockedPr` split into `labelPrBlocked` / `stripArmFromPr` / `stripArmFromIssue` helpers; REST label-shape normalization added to the PR-side strip; buggy `indexOf` guard removed.

# Quality gate — per-function CRAP ratchet via crap4js (IstiN fork).
#
# Policy: CRAP may only DECREASE. The baseline (per-function CRAP of everything above
# CRAP_THRESHOLD) is NOT in the repository …

blocks.text:
# Quality gate — per-function CRAP ratchet via crap4js (IstiN fork).
#
# Policy: CRAP may only DECREASE. The baseline (per-function CRAP of everything above
# CRAP_THRESHOLD) is NOT in the repository — with many agents opening PRs a committed file
# conflicts constantly. It lives in a rolling GitHub release asset:
#
#   release tag  crap-baseline   (prerelease, never "latest" — agent pack consumers resolve
#                                 releases/latest, so this one must not be it)
#   asset        crap-baseline.json
#
# pull_request / workflow_dispatch (the factory SM dispatches this on PR heads): measure the
#   head and COMPARE with the released baseline. Fails when a function's CRAP grew or a new
#   function exceeds CRAP_THRESHOLD; labels crap:regression / crap:improved.
# main (push, merge-bot completion via workflow_run — the bot merges with GITHUB_TOKEN, which
#   never fires 'push' —, or manual dispatch on main): after a green measurement, ratchet the
#   released baseline DOWN (crap4js --update-baseline: min(old, now), never up, refuses on
#   regression) and upload it. The release notes carry 'main@<sha>' so repeated triggers for
#   the same HEAD are skipped. Concurrent merges are serialized by the concurrency group.
# No baseline asset yet (first run / fork): bootstrap from the measured main, no comparison.
#
# Coverage comes from the unit suite run in the same job (instrumented tree), so the
# ratchet is evaluated with the unit-test results of the head.
#
# Tool pin: IstiN/crap4js by commit SHA (fork of vabhzw17eg2qu4m9-bit/crap4js v0.15.0 +
# --baseline / --update-baseline, pipe-safe exit). Installed from GitHub — the npm 'crap4js'
# package is an unrelated third-party project.
name: Quality

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  workflow_run:
    # The merge bot merges with GITHUB_TOKEN, and GitHub suppresses workflow triggers on
    # GITHUB_TOKEN events — the push trigger above never fires for machine merges (same
    # reason agent-pack-release.yml listens to this workflow, gh-867). The bot's own run
    # completion is a normal event. Runs on every bot completion are cheap no-ops: the
    # 'gate' job skips when the baseline already covers main's HEAD.
    workflows: ['Machine Merge Bot']
    types: [completed]
  pull_request:
  workflow_dispatch:  # the Machine SM / sm-kicker dispatch validation runs; on main it re-seeds the baseline

permissions:
  contents: write        # push to main: update the crap-baseline release asset
  pull-requests: write   # crap:regression / crap:improved labels

# Serializes baseline updates of consecutive merges (never cancels a running update).
concurrency:
  group: quality-${{ (github.event_name == 'push' || github.event_name == 'workflow_run' || github.ref == 'refs/heads/main') && 'baseline-update' || github.run_id }}
  cancel-in-progress: false

env:
  # Threshold for functions NOT in crap-baseline.json (new or renamed code).
  CRAP_THRESHOLD: '8'
  CRAP4JS_REPO: 'IstiN/crap4js'
  CRAP4JS_REF: '83ee6201e554a91d51c298f045c5c4cb47317b6d'
  BASELINE_TAG: 'crap-baseline'
  BASELINE_ASSET: 'crap-baseline.json'

jobs:
  gate:
    # PR / dispatch on a PR head: always measure. Main-side events (push, merge-bot completion,
    # manual dispatch on main): measure only when the released baseline does not yet cover HEAD.
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    outputs:
      run: ${{ steps.g.outputs.run }}
    steps:
      - id: g
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
          EVENT: ${{ github.event_name }}
          REF: ${{ github.ref }}
          BOT_CONCLUSION: ${{ github.event.workflow_run.conclusion }}
        run: |
          main_side=false
          [ "$EVENT" = "push" ] || [ "$EVENT" = "workflow_run" ] && main_side=true
          [ "$EVENT" = "workflow_dispatch" ] && [ "$REF" = "refs/heads/main" ] && main_side=true
          if [ "$main_side" != "true" ]; then
            echo "run=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"; exit 0      # pull_request / dispatch on a PR head: always measure
          fi
          if [ "$EVENT" = "workflow_run" ] && [ "$BOT_CONCLUSION" != "success" ]; then
            echo "run=false" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"; echo "merge bot run was not successful — skip"; exit 0
          fi
          body="$(gh release view "$BASELINE_TAG" --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" --json body --jq .body 2>/dev/null || true)"
          if printf '%s' "$body" | grep -q "main@${GITHUB_SHA}"; then
            echo "run=false" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"; echo "baseline already covers ${GITHUB_SHA} — skip"
          else
            echo "run=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          fi

  crap:
    needs: gate
    if: needs.gate.outputs.run == 'true'
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 20

      - name: Install pinned tools (separate prefix — never node_modules here)
        run: |
          npm install --prefix "$RUNNER_TEMP/tools" --no-fund --no-audit \
            "github:${CRAP4JS_REPO}#${CRAP4JS_REF}" nyc@17

      - name: Instrument the tree (harness eval-loads bypass nyc's hook)
        run: |
          "$RUNNER_TEMP/tools/node_modules/.bin/nyc" instrument --cwd . . \
            "$RUNNER_TEMP/inst"
          # nyc instrument copies only .js — add the json/md/sh payloads the
          # suite reads (configs, instructions, prompts, fixtures).
          rsync -a --exclude '*.js' --exclude '.git' ./ "$RUNNER_TEMP/inst/"
          # (the factory board — and its pristine-app source guard — moved to
          # the dmtools-factory repo; nothing browser-side is text-read here anymore)
          # Tests call `git ls-files` (agentDocsCoverage): give the copied tree a throwaway
          # index of the same tracked files, without the real history.
          (cd "$RUNNER_TEMP/inst" && git init -q && git add -A -f . >/dev/null 2>&1 || true)

      - name: Run the unit suite for coverage (instrumented tree)
        # Canonical green-gate is the dmtools-java runner (pack-release test job); the node
        # harness mirrors it (file_*/cli_*/assert/network-guard parity) and must be green too,
        # so a red harness fails this job instead of being swallowed. ci/run_with_coverage.js
        # wraps the harness and dumps the Istanbul global after the run.
        run: |
          cd "$RUNNER_TEMP/inst"
          FILES="$(node -e "console.log(require('./js/unit-tests/run_all.json').params.jobParams.testFiles.join(' '))")"
          node ci/run_with_coverage.js \
            "$RUNNER_TEMP/inst/js/unit-tests/node_testRunner.js" \
            "$RUNNER_TEMP/cov/coverage-final.json" $FILES

      - name: Fetch the released baseline
        id: baseline
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
        run: |
          if gh release download "$BASELINE_TAG" --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" --pattern "$BASELINE_ASSET" \
               --dir "$RUNNER_TEMP/base" --clobber 2>/dev/null && [ -s "$RUNNER_TEMP/base/$BASELINE_ASSET" ]; then
            echo "present=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
            echo "baseline: $(node -e "const b=require('$RUNNER_TEMP/base/$BASELINE_ASSET');console.log(Object.keys(b.functions).length+' functions, max '+b.maxCrap)")"
          else
            echo "present=false" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
            echo "::notice::no $BASELINE_TAG release asset yet — bootstrapping from this run"
          fi

      - name: crap4js ratchet (compare with the released baseline)
        id: ratchet
        if: steps.baseline.outputs.present == 'true'
        run: |
          set +e
          # Redirect to a file (never a pipe): the report is ~500 KB and the verdict block comes last.
          "$RUNNER_TEMP/tools/node_modules/.bin/crap4js" . \
            --coverage "$RUNNER_TEMP/cov/coverage-final.json" \
            --threshold "${CRAP_THRESHOLD}" \
            --baseline "$RUNNER_TEMP/base/$BASELINE_ASSET" > "$RUNNER_TEMP/crap.txt"
          code=$?
          head -30 "$RUNNER_TEMP/crap.txt"
          sed -n '/^CRAP Ratchet/,$p' "$RUNNER_TEMP/crap.txt" | tee -a "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
          if grep -q '^improved ' "$RUNNER_TEMP/crap.txt"; then echo "improved=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"; fi
          e…

# Quality gate — per-function CRAP ratchet via crap4js (IstiN fork).
#
# Policy: CRAP may only DECREASE. The baseline (per-function CRAP of everything above
# CRAP_THRESHOLD) is NOT in the repository …

blocks.text:
# Quality gate — per-function CRAP ratchet via crap4js (IstiN fork).
#
# Policy: CRAP may only DECREASE. The baseline (per-function CRAP of everything above
# CRAP_THRESHOLD) is NOT in the repository — with many agents opening PRs a committed file
# conflicts constantly. It lives in a rolling GitHub release asset:
#
#   release tag  crap-baseline   (prerelease, never "latest" — agent pack consumers resolve
#                                 releases/latest, so this one must not be it)
#   asset        crap-baseline.json
#
# pull_request / workflow_dispatch (the factory SM dispatches this on PR heads): measure the
#   head and COMPARE with the released baseline. Fails when a function's CRAP grew or a new
#   function exceeds CRAP_THRESHOLD; labels crap:regression / crap:improved.
# main (push, merge-bot completion via workflow_run — the bot merges with GITHUB_TOKEN, which
#   never fires 'push' —, or manual dispatch on main): after a green measurement, ratchet the
#   released baseline DOWN (crap4js --update-baseline: min(old, now), never up, refuses on
#   regression) and upload it. The release notes carry 'main@<sha>' so repeated triggers for
#   the same HEAD are skipped. Concurrent merges are serialized by the concurrency group.
# No baseline asset yet (first run / fork): bootstrap from the measured main, no comparison.
#
# Coverage comes from the unit suite run in the same job (instrumented tree), so the
# ratchet is evaluated with the unit-test results of the head.
#
# Tool pin: IstiN/crap4js by commit SHA (fork of vabhzw17eg2qu4m9-bit/crap4js v0.15.0 +
# --baseline / --update-baseline, pipe-safe exit). Installed from GitHub — the npm 'crap4js'
# package is an unrelated third-party project.
name: Quality

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  workflow_run:
    # The merge bot merges with GITHUB_TOKEN, and GitHub suppresses workflow triggers on
    # GITHUB_TOKEN events — the push trigger above never fires for machine merges (same
    # reason agent-pack-release.yml listens to this workflow, gh-867). The bot's own run
    # completion is a normal event. Runs on every bot completion are cheap no-ops: the
    # 'gate' job skips when the baseline already covers main's HEAD.
    workflows: ['Machine Merge Bot']
    types: [completed]
  pull_request:
  workflow_dispatch:  # the Machine SM / sm-kicker dispatch validation runs; on main it re-seeds the baseline

permissions:
  contents: write        # push to main: update the crap-baseline release asset
  pull-requests: write   # crap:regression / crap:improved labels

# Serializes baseline updates of consecutive merges (never cancels a running update).
concurrency:
  group: quality-${{ (github.event_name == 'push' || github.event_name == 'workflow_run' || github.ref == 'refs/heads/main') && 'baseline-update' || github.run_id }}
  cancel-in-progress: false

env:
  # Threshold for functions NOT in crap-baseline.json (new or renamed code).
  CRAP_THRESHOLD: '8'
  CRAP4JS_REPO: 'IstiN/crap4js'
  CRAP4JS_REF: '83ee6201e554a91d51c298f045c5c4cb47317b6d'
  BASELINE_TAG: 'crap-baseline'
  BASELINE_ASSET: 'crap-baseline.json'

jobs:
  gate:
    # PR / dispatch on a PR head: always measure. Main-side events (push, merge-bot completion,
    # manual dispatch on main): measure only when the released baseline does not yet cover HEAD.
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    outputs:
      run: ${{ steps.g.outputs.run }}
    steps:
      - id: g
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
          EVENT: ${{ github.event_name }}
          REF: ${{ github.ref }}
          BOT_CONCLUSION: ${{ github.event.workflow_run.conclusion }}
        run: |
          main_side=false
          [ "$EVENT" = "push" ] || [ "$EVENT" = "workflow_run" ] && main_side=true
          [ "$EVENT" = "workflow_dispatch" ] && [ "$REF" = "refs/heads/main" ] && main_side=true
          if [ "$main_side" != "true" ]; then
            echo "run=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"; exit 0      # pull_request / dispatch on a PR head: always measure
          fi
          if [ "$EVENT" = "workflow_run" ] && [ "$BOT_CONCLUSION" != "success" ]; then
            echo "run=false" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"; echo "merge bot run was not successful — skip"; exit 0
          fi
          body="$(gh release view "$BASELINE_TAG" --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" --json body --jq .body 2>/dev/null || true)"
          if printf '%s' "$body" | grep -q "main@${GITHUB_SHA}"; then
            echo "run=false" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"; echo "baseline already covers ${GITHUB_SHA} — skip"
          else
            echo "run=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          fi

  crap:
    needs: gate
    if: needs.gate.outputs.run == 'true'
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 20

      - name: Install pinned tools (separate prefix — never node_modules here)
        run: |
          npm install --prefix "$RUNNER_TEMP/tools" --no-fund --no-audit \
            "github:${CRAP4JS_REPO}#${CRAP4JS_REF}" nyc@17

      - name: Instrument the tree (harness eval-loads bypass nyc's hook)
        run: |
          "$RUNNER_TEMP/tools/node_modules/.bin/nyc" instrument --cwd . . \
            "$RUNNER_TEMP/inst"
          # nyc instrument copies only .js — add the json/md/sh payloads the
          # suite reads (configs, instructions, prompts, fixtures).
          rsync -a --exclude '*.js' --exclude '.git' ./ "$RUNNER_TEMP/inst/"
          # (the factory board — and its pristine-app source guard — moved to
          # the dmtools-factory repo; nothing browser-side is text-read here anymore)
          # Tests call `git ls-files` (agentDocsCoverage): give the copied tree a throwaway
          # index of the same tracked files, without the real history.
          (cd "$RUNNER_TEMP/inst" && git init -q && git add -A -f . >/dev/null 2>&1 || true)

      - name: Run the unit suite for coverage (instrumented tree)
        # Canonical green-gate is the dmtools-java runner (pack-release test job); the node
        # harness mirrors it (file_*/cli_*/assert/network-guard parity) and must be green too,
        # so a red harness fails this job instead of being swallowed. ci/run_with_coverage.js
        # wraps the harness and dumps the Istanbul global after the run.
        run: |
          cd "$RUNNER_TEMP/inst"
          FILES="$(node -e "console.log(require('./js/unit-tests/run_all.json').params.jobParams.testFiles.join(' '))")"
          node ci/run_with_coverage.js \
            "$RUNNER_TEMP/inst/js/unit-tests/node_testRunner.js" \
            "$RUNNER_TEMP/cov/coverage-final.json" $FILES

      - name: Fetch the released baseline
        id: baseline
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
        run: |
          if gh release download "$BASELINE_TAG" --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" --pattern "$BASELINE_ASSET" \
               --dir "$RUNNER_TEMP/base" --clobber 2>/dev/null && [ -s "$RUNNER_TEMP/base/$BASELINE_ASSET" ]; then
            echo "present=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
            echo "baseline: $(node -e "const b=require('$RUNNER_TEMP/base/$BASELINE_ASSET');console.log(Object.keys(b.functions).length+' functions, max '+b.maxCrap)")"
          else
            echo "present=false" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
            echo "::notice::no $BASELINE_TAG release asset yet — bootstrapping from this run"
          fi

      - name: crap4js ratchet (compare with the released baseline)
        id: ratchet
        if: steps.baseline.outputs.present == 'true'
        run: |
          set +e
          # Redirect to a file (never a pipe): the report is ~500 KB and the verdict block comes last.
          "$RUNNER_TEMP/tools/node_modules/.bin/crap4js" . \
            --coverage "$RUNNER_TEMP/cov/coverage-final.json" \
            --threshold "${CRAP_THRESHOLD}" \
            --baseline "$RUNNER_TEMP/base/$BASELINE_ASSET" > "$RUNNER_TEMP/crap.txt"
          code=$?
          head -30 "$RUNNER_TEMP/crap.txt"
          sed -n '/^CRAP Ratchet/,$p' "$RUNNER_TEMP/crap.txt" | tee -a "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
          if grep -q '^improved ' "$RUNNER_TEMP/crap.txt"; then echo "improved=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"; fi
